newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy cities' Oct CPI data due Oct 21/22 - Istat.
newsitem.headline: Italy cities' Oct CPI data due Oct 21/22 - Istat.

text.p: Preliminary CPI data for October from the 10 Italian sample cities will be issued on October 21 and 22, national statistics institute Istat announced.

On Monday, October 21, Turin, Milan and Trieste will give their data while on Tuesday October 22, figures will be issued by Genoa, Venice, Bologna, Florence, Perugia, Naples and Palermo. The data will be given at 1530 GMT each day.
Istat will announce the final national consumer price inflation rate for October on November 6.
September year-on-year inflation came in at 3.4 percent, unchanged on August.
